interpretations.rationale: The student describes the difficulty of understanding what the data on the screens actually represents and whether it can be used, which reflects a problem-solving struggle around interpreting experimental results.
interpretations.why_interesting: It shows that even when data is visible, students still face a cognitive gap between observation and conceptual understanding, highlighting that data collection alone does not guarantee comprehension.
interpretations.teaching_implication: Labs could include guided prompts asking students to explain what a given screen/reading physically represents before proceeding, to bridge observation and interpretation (speculative).

interpretations.rationale: The student explicitly states that without prior theoretical background (optics) they would have had no idea what they were doing, directly describing a problem-solving challenge tied to missing prerequisite knowledge.
